explanations.10: The %% notation is a placeholder syntax — the actual port number will be substituted here when the docker-compose file is processed by the tool that launches it.
explanations.16: This IP address and port point to where the Ollama service (the AI model backend) is running; the container needs this address to communicate with that service.
explanations.20: This is another reference to the same Ollama service, but specifically for generating embeddings, which are numerical representations of text used for similarity searching.
explanations.28: This creates a persistent storage location that survives container restarts — without it, data inside the container would be lost when the container stops.
